name: speckit-dag-hooks
description: DEPRECATED — superseded by speckit-gate (github.com/srobroek/speckit-gate). Kept for existing installs; no new features. Opt-in enforcement hooks for the SpecKit DAG: hard-block out-of-order or precondition-violating /speckit.* commands via the speckit-dag dispatcher. Opinionated mandatory-gating -- requires the speckit package (which ships the dispatcher) to be installed.
